title: Analyzing trogocytosis of T lymphocytes by flow cytometry and confocal microscopy
protocol: Thaw cryo-preserved donor cells into 15 mL Falcon tube.
Add PBS to achieve a final volume of 10 mL in the Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of cell culture medium.
Transfer each cell line into a separate 25 cm² (or T25) cell culture flask and add 4 mL of culture medium to each flask.
Store the cell culture flasks in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator until further use.
Once adherent donor cells reach 80%-90% confluence, aspirate the medium and rinse the donor cells once with 5 mL PBS, then discard PBS.
Add 0.5-1 mL of 0.05% trypsin to detach cells from cell culture flask for 2-5 minutes at 37°C.
Stop trypsinization by adding 4 mL of cell culture medium to the detached cells.
Dilute poly-L-ornithine stock in sterile H2O to a final concentration of 0.01% (w/v 0.1 mg/mL).
Add 500 μL of 0.01% poly-L-ornithine coating solution to 35 mm glass bottom μ-dishes.
Incubate for 1 h at approximately 20°C or for 16–18 h at 4°C.
Aspirate coating solution without scratching the coated surface.
Dry dish at normal lab temperatures (19°C–23°C) for 30–60 min.
Aspirate medium from donor cells and rinse them once with 5 mL PBS.
Aspirate PBS.
Add 0.5–1 ml of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA and incubate for 2–5 min at 37°C until cells detach from cell culture flask.
Stop trypsinization by adding 4 ml of cell culture medium.
Harvest cells into a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Pipette up and down several times to singulate cells.
Count cells using a Neubauer counting chamber or other suitable counting device.
Adjust the concentration of cells by dilution with cell culture medium as needed.
Seed donor cells in a 35 mm glass bottom μ-dish for microscopic analyses.
Incubate seeded cells for 16-18 hours in a humidified 37°C 5% CO2 incubator.
Transfer blood sample to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add 25 mL of Versene buffer to the blood sample.
Prepare another 50 mL tube filled with 15 mL Histopaque-1077.
Carefully layer the Versene-diluted blood sample onto the Histopaque using a 25 mL pipette.
Centrifuge at 1,160 × g for 15 min at normal lab temperatures (19°C–23°C) without brake.
Collect the layer of PBMCs identified as a white band between the Histopaque and serum layers.
Wash PBMC twice with BSS/BSA buffer.
Centrifuge PBMC at 430 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 10 mL of PBMC culture medium.
Adjust concentration of recipient cells to 1.5 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Carefully remove medium from donor cell culture.
Add 200 μL (3 × 10^4 recipient cells) to donor cells cultured in 96-well plates for flow cytometry experiments.
Add 660 μL (1 × 10^5 recipient cells) to donor cells cultured in 35 mm glass bottom μ-dish for fluorescence microscopy-based experiments.
Incubate co-cultured donor and recipient cells in a humidified 37°C 5% CO2 incubator for the desired amount of time.
Perform a brief centrifugation step (e.g., 200 × g, 30 s, 4°C) to accelerate cell alignment.
Carefully collect and discard 100 μL supernatant from each well without removing the cells at the bottom.
Per well add 100 μL ice-cold FACS Buffer (aids in detaching the cells from one another).
Carefully pipet up and down several times.
Aim the flow generated by pipetting to all areas of the well without touching the bottom of the plate.
Transfer 200 μL of cell suspension to a new 96-well u- or v-shaped plate.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Prepare a staining mix of antibodies in FACS buffer during the centrifugation step.
Use Anti-human CD4-FITC antibody (1:200 dilution) and Anti-mouse CD8α-APC antibody (1:100 dilution) for primary human T cells (PBMCs) and 58αβ T cell lymphoma cell line, respectively.
Remove and discard the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend pelleted cells in 30 μL staining mix.
Incubate the resuspended cells at 4°C for 20–30 min in the dark.
Add 180 μL cold FACS buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the samples at 400× g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully after centrifugation.
Repeat steps from resuspending pelleted cells if necessary.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL of ice-cold FACS buffer.
Analyze cells by flow cytometry.
Alternatively, permeabilize and stain cells for intracellular molecules.
Fix cells by adding 500 μL of a 4% formaldehyde solution to reach a final concentration of 2%.
Incubate the fixed cells for 15 min at normal lab temperatures (19°C–23°C) in the dark.
Carefully pour off the fixative from the dish without disturbing the cell-coated area.
Wash the dish three times with 3 mL PBS, adding it to the dish without directly pipetting onto the cells.
Pour out the PBS solution from the dish carefully.
Tilt the dish at a 45° angle and remove residual liquid with tissue or pipet.
Remove all PBS from dish.
Add 200 μL of 5 μg/mL WGA-CF405S conjugate diluted in HBSS for cell membrane labeling.
Incubate for 10 min at RT.
Wash cells twice with HBSS as described in step 43.
Add 3 mL of fresh HBSS to dish.
Analyze cells using a fluorescence microscope.
